name: CTI Electric
old_description: At CTI Electric, we’re dedicated to providing exceptional electrical solutions for commercial, industrial, and manufacturing clients. With our commitment to superior customer service, expertise, and professionalism, we empower businesses with the highest standards of safety, quality, and reliability.
about:
CTI Electric is based in Clearfield, Utah, and has provided electrical solutions for more than two decades. The company serves commercial, industrial, and manufacturing clients across six counties in the Greater Salt Lake area.

The firm delivers a full range of electrical construction and service capabilities, including lightning protection, medium‑voltage distribution, design‑build projects, general electrical installation, preventive maintenance, coordination studies, switchgear work, emergency power systems, troubleshooting, and industrial automation controls. It also provides integrated security solutions such as intrusion detection, access control, CCTV, and fire alarm systems, plus low‑voltage structured cabling for telecommunications and cathodic protection.

CTI Electric works with general contractors, industrial manufacturers, aerospace facilities, and utility providers. Named references include R&O Construction, Northern Construction, Boeing, and City Light & Power, illustrating a customer base that spans commercial construction, aerospace manufacturing, and public‑power utilities.

The company distinguishes itself as one of only two Utah contractors certified by the Lightning Protection Institute. It emphasizes a design‑build approach, specialty‑certified tradespeople, and a single‑source model that combines electrical, security, and low‑voltage services under one roof.
